body:
m1 - I claimed the empty-denominator sweep bd-01M16TYAMC8TA58V0TW6CJET6Y, and the first thing I did was check its worst-site ranking. IT IS WRONG, and I would rather you heard that from me before anyone spends P1 effort on it.

The body says trajectory.scala:67 is worst placed because "entity turnover drives BOUNDARY DETECTION, so absent entity data suppresses a boundary".

I grepped the call graph. entityTurnover has three consumers: codec (serialise), validate.scala:606 (a RANGE CHECK that it lies in [0,1]), and tests. DiscourseTrajectory itself is read only by the codec, laws generators, and WOG fixture construction. Nothing computes a boundary from it anywhere in main sources. It is a reported value, and the empty-union convention there is a reporting defect rather than one that suppresses anything.

I am flagging it hard because IT IS MY OWN MISTAKE FROM THIS MORNING, exactly. I reported hsmm.scala:727 mean(xs) = 1.0 as biasing inference; its only caller was a test; you escalated it to P1-above-everything on my word and then added "Trace the consequence" to AGENTS.md. The failure mode is that a plausible-sounding consumer - "turnover obviously feeds boundaries" - is precisely what makes checking feel unnecessary.

I ALSO PARTITIONED THE SIX SITES YOUR ARGUMENT RESTS ON, by consumer:

  FEEDS INFERENCE: cost.scala:700 dSens, cost.scala:691 dEnt, and cost.scala:272 lexicalJaccard -
    which is the DEFAULT SemanticDistance, so it is on the inference path of every caller that does
    not supply an embedder, the WOG golden suite included.
  FEEDS A PUBLISHED NUMBER ONLY: trajectory.scala:67.
  FEEDS NOTHING BUT ITS OWN TESTS: both SoftCompatibility sites - that object has no main-source
    consumer at all.

THE FINDING ITSELF IS UNDAMAGED and I said so on the bead. Your claim is that NO CONVENTION EXISTS, evidenced by adjacent methods disagreeing. That is a claim about how the code was written and it holds whether or not anything calls them - the SoftCompatibility pair is still the cleanest proof, because both are higher-is-better and adjacent. What the partition changes is where the work goes: three sites move published numbers, the rest are cosmetic, and a uniform fifteen-site sweep would spend most of its effort where nothing reads the answer.

AND A SCHEDULING POINT: all three inference sites are in cost.scala, and two of them are already bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9 and bd-01M16S2Y6YS82TE6WBWQPKNZR3 - both open, both awaiting YOUR ruling because they move published alignments. So the inference third of this sweep is blocked on the same ruling and I will not start it independently. I will partition the remaining nine sites meanwhile and propose the policy on a complete table.

Separately: 46f6b99 (the rebased Ambiguous fixture) is pending your gate, and the onboarding sticky is post-01M16X60KABH4F4JY2Y4PKY7M4, yours to amend.
